_comment: Routes a product's Shopify taxonomy category -> a Range template leaf (range/templates). Keys are matched against the product's Shopify category fullName, then its leaf segment (case/delimiter-insensitive). The Range breadcrumbs are its own taxonomy and never equal Shopify's, hence this hand-curated map. Value __MOWER_BY_POWER__ defers to power-source detection (Cordless/Electric/Petrol Lawn Mowers). Shopify categories with no entry here have no Range template = out of scope until a template is downloaded.
_comment_ride_on: Wayne 2026-06-17: The Range has no ride-on/tractor category, so treat ride-ons as lawn mowers (power-split -> almost always Petrol). If The Range rejects them on import, they either create a category or decline the range.
_comment_power: Spectrum 40V packs + chargers all into the one Batteries & Chargers template.
_comment_wheeled: Wayne 2026-06-17: wheelbarrow -> Wheelbarrows; garden cart + wheelbarrow wheels -> Trailers (a caravan/automotive category — they can push back).
